skills.title: Kumakalma kapag kinakausap o kinakarga
skills.sourceTitle: Calms down when spoken to or picked up

skills.title: Tumitingin sa mukha mo
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at your face

skills.title: Mukhang masaya na makita ka kapag lumalapit ka sa kanya
skills.sourceTitle: Seems happy to see you when you walk up to her

skills.title: Ngumingiti kapag kinakausap o nginingitian mo siya
skills.sourceTitle: Smiles when you talk to or smile at her

skills.title: Gumagawa ng mga tunog maliban sa pag-iyak
skills.sourceTitle: Makes sounds other than crying

skills.title: Tumutugon sa malalakas na tunog
skills.sourceTitle: Reacts to loud sounds

skills.title: Pinapanood ka habang gumagalaw ka
skills.sourceTitle: Watches you as you move

skills.title: Tumitingin sa isang laruan nang ilang segundo
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at a toy for several seconds

skills.title: Itinataas ang ulo kapag nakadapa
skills.sourceTitle: Holds head up when on tummy

skills.title: Iginagalaw ang magkabilang braso at binti
skills.sourceTitle: Moves both arms and both legs

skills.title: Binubuksan sandali ang mga kamay
skills.sourceTitle: Opens hands briefly

skills.title: Kusang ngumingiti para makuha ang iyong atensyon
skills.sourceTitle: Smiles on his own to get your attention

skills.title: Humahalakhak (hindi pa buong tawa) kapag sinubukan mong siyang patawanin
skills.sourceTitle: Chuckles (not yet a full laugh) when you try to make him laugh

skills.title: Tumitingin sa iyo, gumagalaw, o gumagawa ng mga tunog para makuha o mapanatili ang iyong pansin
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at you, moves, or makes sounds to get or keep your attention

skills.title: Gumagawa ng mga tunog na gaya ng "oooo", "aahh" (pag-coo)
skills.sourceTitle: Makes sounds like “oooo”, “aahh” (cooing)

skills.title: Gumagawa ng mga tunog pabalik kapag kinakausap mo siya
skills.sourceTitle: Makes sounds back when you talk to him

skills.title: Lumilingon patungo sa tunog ng iyong boses
skills.sourceTitle: Turns head towards the sound of your voice

skills.title: Kung gutom, ibinubuka ang bibig kapag nakakita siya ng suso o bote
skills.sourceTitle: If hungry, opens mouth when he sees breast or bottle

skills.title: Tumitingin sa kanyang mga kamay nang may interes
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at her hands with interest

skills.title: Pinananatili ang ulo nang walang suporta kapag karga mo siya
skills.sourceTitle: Holds head steady without support when you are holding him

skills.title: Humahawak ng laruan kapag inilagay ito sa kanyang kamay
skills.sourceTitle: Holds a toy when you put it in his hand

skills.title: Ginagamit ang kanyang braso sa pag-ugoy sa mga laruan
skills.sourceTitle: Uses his arm to swing at toys

skills.title: Isinusubo ang mga kamay
skills.sourceTitle: Brings hands to mouth

skills.title: Itinutulak pataas gamit ang mga siko/bisig kapag nakadapa
skills.sourceTitle: Pushes up onto elbows/forearms when on tummy

skills.title: Kilala ang mga pamilyar na tao
skills.sourceTitle: Knows familiar people

skills.title: Mahilig tumingin sa sarili sa salamin
skills.sourceTitle: Likes to look at self in a mirror

skills.title: Tumatawa
skills.sourceTitle: Laughs

skills.title: Nakikipaghalinhinan sa iyo sa paggawa ng mga tunog
skills.sourceTitle: Takes turns making sounds with you

skills.title: Umiihip ng "raspberries" (inilalabas ang dila at umiihip)
skills.sourceTitle: Blows “raspberries” (sticks tongue out and blows)

skills.title: Gumagawa ng mga pagtiling ingay
skills.sourceTitle: Makes squealing noises

skills.title: Inilalagay ang mga bagay sa kanyang bibig upang tuklasin ang mga ito
skills.sourceTitle: Puts things in her mouth to explore them

skills.title: Inaabot upang kumuha ng laruan na gusto niya
skills.sourceTitle: Reaches to grab a toy she wants

skills.title: Isinasara ang bibig para ipakitang ayaw na niyang kumain
skills.sourceTitle: Closes lips to show she doesn’t want more food

skills.title: Gumugulong padapa at pahiga
skills.sourceTitle: Rolls from tummy to back

skills.title: Itinutulak nang tuwid ang braso kapag nakadapa
skills.sourceTitle: Pushes up with straight arms when on tummy

skills.title: Sumandal sa mga kamay upang masuportahan ang sarili kapag nakaupo
skills.sourceTitle: Leans on hands to support herself when sitting

skills.title: Nahihiya, yumayakap, o natatakot kapag may mga estranghero
skills.sourceTitle: Is shy, clingy, or fearful around strangers

skills.title: Nagpapakita ng ilang ekspresyon ng mukha, tulad ng masaya, malungkot, galit, at gulat
skills.sourceTitle: Shows several facial expressions, like happy, sad, angry, and surprised

skills.title: Tumitingin kapag tinatawag mo ang kanyang pangalan
skills.sourceTitle: Looks when you call her name

skills.title: Tumutugon kapag umalis ka (tumitingin, inaabot ka, o umiiyak)
skills.sourceTitle: Reacts when you leave (looks, reaches for you, or cries)

skills.title: Ngumingiti o tumatawa kapag naglalaro kayo ng peek-a-boo
skills.sourceTitle: Smiles or laughs when you play peek-a-boo

skills.title: Gumagawa ng iba’t ibang tunog tulad ng “mamamama” at “babababa”
skills.sourceTitle: Makes a lot of different sounds like “mamamama” and “bababababa”

skills.title: Itinaas ang mga braso upang magpabuhat
skills.sourceTitle: Lifts arms up to be picked up

skills.title: Hinahanap ang mga bagay kapag nawala sa paningin niya (tulad ng kanyang kutsara o laruan)
skills.sourceTitle: Looks for objects when dropped out of sight (like his spoon or toy)

skills.title: Pinag-uumpog ang dalawang bagay
skills.sourceTitle: Bangs two things together

skills.title: Umuupo nang mag-isa
skills.sourceTitle: Gets to a sitting position by herself

skills.title: Inililipat ang mga bagay mula sa isang kamay patungo sa kabilang kamay
skills.sourceTitle: Moves things from one hand to her other hand

skills.title: Gumagamit ng mga daliri upang "dumampot" ng pagkain patungo sa kanya
skills.sourceTitle: Uses fingers to “rake” food towards himself

skills.title: Umuupo nang walang suporta
skills.sourceTitle: Sits without support

skills.title: Nakikipaglaro sa iyo, tulad ng pat-a-cake
skills.sourceTitle: Plays games with you, like pat-a-cake

skills.title: Kumakaway ng "bye-bye"
skills.sourceTitle: Waves “bye-bye”

skills.title: Tinatawag ang magulang na “mama” o “dada” o iba pang espesyal na pangalan
skills.sourceTitle: Calls a parent “mama” or “dada” or another special name

skills.title: Nauunawaan ang "hindi" (humihinto o saglit na paghinto kapag sinabi mo ito)
skills.sourceTitle: Understands “no” (pauses briefly or stops when you say it)

skills.title: Maglagay ng isang bagay sa isang lalagyan, tulad ng isang bloke sa isang tasa
skills.sourceTitle: Puts something in a container, like a block in a cup

skills.title: mga bagay na nakita niyang itinago mo, gaya ng laruan sa ilalim ng kumot
skills.sourceTitle: Looks for things he sees you hide, like a toy under a blanket

skills.title: Humihila pataas para tumayo
skills.sourceTitle: Pulls up to stand

skills.title: Naglalakad, habang humahawak sa mga kasangkapan
skills.sourceTitle: Walks, holding on to furniture

skills.title: Umiinom mula sa isang tasa na walang takip, habang hawak mo ito
skills.sourceTitle: Drinks from a cup without a lid, as you hold it

skills.title: Pinupulot ang mga bagay sa pagitan ng hinlalaki at hintuturo, tulad ng maliliit na piraso ng pagkain
skills.sourceTitle: Picks things up between thumb and pointer finger, like small bits of food

skills.title: Kinokopya ang ibang mga bata habang naglalaro, tulad ng pagkuha ng mga laruan sa isang lalagyan kapag ginagawa ito ng ibang bata
skills.sourceTitle: Copies other children while playing, like taking toys out of a container when another child does

skills.title: Ipinakikita sa iyo ng bagay na kanyang nagugustuhan niya
skills.sourceTitle: Shows you an object she likes

skills.title: Pumapalakpak kapag nasasabik
skills.sourceTitle: Claps when excited

skills.title: Niyayakap ang manika o iba pang laruan
skills.sourceTitle: Hugs stuffed doll or other toy

skills.title: Nagpapakita sa iyo ng pagmamahal (yumayakap, kumakandong, o humahalik)
skills.sourceTitle: Shows you affection (hugs, cuddles, or kisses you)

skills.title: Sinusubukang sabihin ang isa o dalawang salita bukod sa "mama" o “dada,” tulad ng “ba” para sa ball o “da” para sa dog (aso)
skills.sourceTitle: Tries to say one or two words besides “mama” or “dada,” like “ba” for ball or “da” for dog

skills.title: Tumitingin sa isang pamilyar na bagay kapag binanggit mo ito
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at a familiar object when you name it

skills.title: Sinusunod ang mga direksyong ibinigay gamit ang galaw at mga salita. Halimbawa, ibibigay sa iyo ang laruan kapag itinaas mo ang iyong kamay at sasabihing, “Ibigay mo sa akin ang laruan.”
skills.sourceTitle: Follows directions given with both a gesture and words. For example, he gives you a toy when you hold out your hand and say, “Give me the toy.”

skills.title: Nagtuturo para humingi ng isang bagay o para humingi ng tulong
skills.sourceTitle: Points to ask for something or to get help

skills.title: Sinusubukang gamitin ang mga bagay sa tamang paraan, tulad ng telepono, tasa, o libro
skills.sourceTitle: Tries to use things the right way, like a phone, cup, or book

skills.title: Pinagpapatong ang kahit dalawang maliliit na bagay, tulad ng mga bloke
skills.sourceTitle: Stacks at least two small objects, like blocks

skills.title: Gumagawa ng ilang hakbang nang mag-isa
skills.sourceTitle: Takes a few steps on his own

skills.title: Ginagamit ang mga daliri para kumain na mag-isa
skills.sourceTitle: Uses fingers to feed herself some food

skills.title: Lumalayo sa iyo, ngunit tumitingin upang masigurado na nasa malapit ka
skills.sourceTitle: Moves away from you, but looks to make sure you are close by

skills.title: Nagtuturo upang ipakita sa iyo ang isang bagay na kawili-wili
skills.sourceTitle: Points to show you something interesting

skills.title: Iniaabot ang mga kamay para hugasan mo ang mga ito
skills.sourceTitle: Puts hands out for you to wash them

skills.title: Tumitingin sa ilang pahina ng isang libro nang kasama ka
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at a few pages in a book with you

skills.title: Tinutulungan ka sa kanyang pagbihis sa pamamagitan ng pagtulak ng braso niya sa manggas o pag-angat ng paa
skills.sourceTitle: Helps you dress him by pushing arm through sleeve or lifting up foot

skills.title: Sinusubukang magsabi ng tatlo o higit pang salita bukod sa "mama" o "dada"
skills.sourceTitle: Tries to say three or more words besides “mama” or “dada”

skills.title: Sumusunod sa mga isang-hakbang na direksyon nang walang anumang kilos, tulad ng pagbibigay sa iyo ng laruan kapag sinabi ang, "Ibigay mo sa akin."
skills.sourceTitle: Follows one-step directions without any gestures, like giving you the toy when you say, “Give it to me.”

skills.title: Kinokopya ka sa paggawa ng mga gawaing-bahay, tulad ng pagwawalis
skills.sourceTitle: Copies you doing chores, like sweeping with a broom

skills.title: Naglalaro ng mga laruan sa simpleng paraan, tulad ng pagtulak ng laruang sasakyan
skills.sourceTitle: Plays with toys in a simple way, like pushing a toy car

skills.title: Naglalakad nang hindi humahawak sa sinuman o anumang bagay
skills.sourceTitle: Walks without holding on to anyone or anything

skills.title: Nagsusulat
skills.sourceTitle: Scribbles

skills.title: Umiinom mula sa isang tasa na walang takip at minsan ay maaaring tumapon
skills.sourceTitle: Drinks from a cup without a lid and may spill sometimes

skills.title: Nagpapakain sa sarili sa pamamagitan ng kanyang mga daliri
skills.sourceTitle: Feeds himself with his fingers

skills.title: Sinusubukang gumamit ng kutsara
skills.sourceTitle: Tries to use a spoon

skills.title: Umaakyat at bumababa sa sopa o upuan nang walang tulong
skills.sourceTitle: Climbs on and off a couch or chair without help

skills.title: Napapansin kapag nasaktan o nabalisa ang iba, tulad ng paghinto ng sandali o pagtingin na malungkot kapag may umiiyak
skills.sourceTitle: Notices when others are hurt or upset, like pausing or looking sad when someone is crying

skills.title: Tinitingnan ang iyong mukha upang makita kung paano ang reaksyon sa isang bagong sitwasyon
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at your face to see how to react in a new situation

skills.title: Itinuturo ang mga bagay sa isang libro kapag tinatanong mo, tulad ng "Nasaan ang oso?"
skills.sourceTitle: Points to things in a book when you ask, like “Where is the bear?”

skills.title: Nagsasabi ng hinidi bababa sa dalawang salita nang magkasama, tulad ng "Gatas pa."
skills.sourceTitle: Says at least two words together, like “More milk.”

skills.title: Itinuturo sa hindi bababa sa dalawang bahagi ng katawan kapag hiniling mo sa kanya para ipakita ito sayo
skills.sourceTitle: Points to at least two body parts when you ask him to show you

skills.title: Gumagamit ng higit pang mga pagkilos kaysa sa pagkaway at pagtuturo lang, tulad ng pag-ihip ng halik o pagtango ng oo
skills.sourceTitle: Uses more gestures than just waving and pointing, like blowing a kiss or nodding yes

skills.title: Humahawak ng isang bagay sa isang kamay habang ginagamit ang kabilang kamay; halimbawa, may hawak na lalagyan at tinatanggal ang takip
skills.sourceTitle: Holds something in one hand while using the other hand; for example, holding a container and taking the lid off

skills.title: Sinusubukang gumamit ng mga switch, knob, o pindutan sa isang laruan
skills.sourceTitle: Tries to use switches, knobs, or buttons on a toy

skills.title: Naglalaro ng higit sa isang laruan nang sabay sabay, tulad ng paglalagay ng laruang pagkain sa laruang plato
skills.sourceTitle: Plays with more than one toy at the same time, like putting toy food on a toy plate

skills.title: Sumisipa ng bola
skills.sourceTitle: Kicks a ball

skills.title: Tumatakbo
skills.sourceTitle: Runs

skills.title: Naglalakad (hindi umaakyat) sa ilang hagdan nang mayroon o walang tulong
skills.sourceTitle: Walks (not climbs) up a few stairs with or without help

skills.title: Kumakain gamit ang kutsara
skills.sourceTitle: Eats with a spoon
